title: 313.3.10 Ceiling suspended packaged HVAC units with compressors.

blocks.html: Equipment such as heat pumps, air-conditioning units, or similar equipment, that is suspended from a structure shall be resiliently supported from or on the building structure. Vibration isolators shall have a minimum isolation efficiency of 90 percent at the lowest disturbing frequency.
